newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Saudi's National Shipping in $427 mln Chase deal.
newsitem.headline: Saudi's National Shipping in $427 mln Chase deal.

text.p: National Shipping Company of Saudi Arabia said Sunday it had signed two financing facilities worth $427 million with Chase Manhattan Bank.

A statement said the first deal worth $300 million would be used to refinance the purchase of five very large crude carriers (VLCC) and the second worth $127 million to finance the building of three container ships.
NSCSA, 28.8 percent owned by the Saudi government, has already taken delivery of the five VLCCs built at a cost of around $400 million by Japan's Mitsubishi Heavy Industries.
The ships will carry crude produced by state-run Saudi Aramco under a three-year agreement signed last year with Aramco shipping arm Vela International Marine.
The statement said South Korea's Samsung would build three container ships for NSCSA. The vessels would be delivered in 1999.
